question.:question/problem: Find the derivative of $y =-2\sin x + \sec x - 3\tan x + 11x$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
We take the derivative of each term and then add them, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-2\sin x+\sec x-3\tan x+11x) \\ & =-2\cos x+\sec x\tan x-3\sec^2 x+11\end{aligned}
$$
